registers.name: SR

registers.name: DR
registers.side_effects: Read consumes received data; write queues transmit data.

registers.name: BRR
registers.side_effects: Change only while communication is quiescent.

fields.name: DIV_Mantissa
fields.meaning: OVER8=0; BRR=0x016D at PCLK1=42 MHz and 115200 baud; see reviewed formula.
